Ravi: Heads up: support case where long-running worker lost access after we tightened derived-token TTLs. Need an auth pattern for long-lived jobs that doesn't weaken overall security.
Courtney: Short summary of constraints: 1) no DB hop in hot path for normal requests, 2) allow a safe path for long-running jobs, 3) strong audit/approval for granting extended tokens.
Ibrahim: Proposal: 'host-bound derived tokens' issued via POST /v1/auth/exchange with a host-attestation. Attestation = signed nonce by pre-registered machine key or HMAC using a machine secret. Token contains cnf.hmac_key_id and host fingerprint.
Maya: Onboarding: require ops/admin to register machine key/fingerprint in Console and approve. For Dedicated/Private, allow PKCS#11 or customer KMS attestation. For hosted, provide simple machine secret upload with one-time verification.
Ravi: Revocation: canonical key revoke must invalidate all derived tokens. Mechanisms: short TTLs, pubsub invalidation to edge runtimes, and a lightweight Redis blacklist for long-lived token JTIs.
Courtney: Edge verification: derived tokens are self-contained and signed; edge runtimes fetch a keyset (jwks) from control-plane CDN or local config for private deployments. Verification is purely local except revocation checks.
Ibrahim: Need to limit scope in derived tokens: include issued_for list (projects/services) with size cap. Reject exchanges that ask for wildcard scopes.
Maya: Console UX: checkbox on key: 'Allow long-lived job tokens (admin approval required)'. Audit trail entry when admin approves. Also display issuance rate and active derived tokens.
Ravi: Security controls: require two-admin approvals to enable long-lived on org-level keys; project keys can be one-admin by default. Rate-limit exchanges per canonical key and per IP.
Courtney: Implementation spike: middleware in edge runtime (Rust) to verify tokens, check revocation bloom, and validate cnf HMAC when present. Fallback to control-plane introspection only on failure.
Ibrahim: Signing key rotation: publish kid in token header. Runtimes accept previous key for grace window. On rotation, optionally force exchange for tokens issued before rotation.
Maya: Backwards compatibility: keep existing token headers; add cnf and issued_for claims. Older runtimes will ignore cnf and accept only short tokens. We'll gate enforcement by runtime version.
infra-bot: Created GH issues #4320 (edge-middleware-spike), #4321 (console-onboarding-ux), #4322 (revocation-bloom-design).
Ravi: Action items: Ibrahim + Courtney do edge spike (ETA 1w). Maya to draft console approval flow (ETA 3d). I'll draft the migration playbook and incident recovery steps.
Ibrahim: One more: for customer-private deployments, provide config to disable external jwks fetch and point to local jwks url.
Maya: Good call. Also include an incident play: forced revocation -> mass notify -> rotate canonical key -> revoke derived JTIs -> provide temporary allowlist for jobs after verification.
Ravi: Any objections?
Courtney: None. Just flag: need load testing for revocation bloom pubsub to ensure scale.
Ibrahim: I'll include load test in spike.
Ravi: OK closing; will drop a short RFC doc in this channel and attach link to GH issues. :white_check_mark:
